about
About Us

Cousins, Michael and Bobby, started their first joint business venture, a lawn-care business when they were 16. It was very successful and they operated it for a few years. After college, they decided to get into the insurance business and started a company that they have been operating for over 15 years. In 2010, they decided to change directions and delve into the restaurant business. In April of 2011, they opened their first Mexican restaurant in McDonough, Georgia. The restaurant was a smashing success so they decided to open a second location on the Gulf Coast in Gulf Shores, Alabama in March of 2013. Bobby's mother/ Michael’s aunt, Brenda Wade, came on board as a third partner. They then opened their third location in Pensacola, Florida in September of 2014. In 2016, the demand in Orange Beach led us to the beautiful location on Canal Road that opened before the summer season. After two years of building our brand, we expanded to the wonderful Section Place project in downtown Fairhope and a second location in Orange Beach on Perdido Beach Blvd. As 2019 has blessed us with an opportunity in downtown Pensacola, we are excited to announce our opening at 22 Palafox Place (Now Open).

We look forward to serving you and yours in any of our six current locations!
